name: Habo
description: Privacy-first habit tracker for iOS and Android. E2EE sync, self-hostable, built with Flutter.
readme_summary: Habo is a privacy-focused, open-source habit tracker for iOS and Android. It offers end-to-end encrypted synchronization, automatic encrypted backups, and self-hosting capabilities, ensuring users maintain full control over their data.
primary_use_case: Tracking personal habits with a strong emphasis on user privacy and data control, including options for secure cloud sync or self-hosting.
cover_image_prompt: A minimalist, serene digital garden where each plant represents a habit. A gentle, glowing digital lock hovers protectively over the garden, symbolizing end-to-end encryption. A small, stylized cloud icon with a padlock emits secure data streams that nourish the plants, representing encrypted sync and backups. Subtle lines of code or data particles flow around the scene, hinting at the underlying technology. The overall mood is peaceful and secure, with a clean, modern aesthetic. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with soft, ambient lighting and a color palette of greens, blues, and subtle metallic accents, with the name 'Habo' subtly integrated into a garden marker.

name: parlor
description: On-device, real-time multimodal AI with features similar to GPT-Live
readme_summary: Parlor is a Python-based, on-device, real-time multimodal AI system designed to provide a voice assistant experience similar to GPT-Live. It processes audio and visual input locally, enabling features like hands-free turn-taking, streaming responses, and barge-in capabilities.
key_features: Action detection (timers, modes, research) via separate JSON output
Optional background research using frontier models
Optimized for Apple Silicon with MLX
primary_use_case: To create a local, real-time, multimodal AI voice assistant experience comparable to advanced services like GPT-Live, running entirely on the user's device.
cover_image_prompt: A friendly, anthropomorphic robot with a microphone and a small camera integrated into its head, sitting at a desk. It's actively listening to a person speaking (represented by sound waves flowing towards the robot) and simultaneously processing visual information from a small, floating screen displaying abstract shapes. The robot is then responding, with clear speech bubbles emanating from it, and a subtle glow of digital information flowing around it. In the background, a stylized, minimalist representation of a home office environment. Small, subtle UI elements like a timer icon and a search magnifying glass are visible on the robot's desk. The overall mood is helpful and intelligent. The art style should be a clean, 3D isometric illustration with a bright, inviting color palette.

name: rybbit
description: 🐸 Rybbit - open-source and privacy-friendly alternative to Google Analytics that is 10x more intuitive.
readme_summary: Rybbit is an open-source, privacy-friendly alternative to Google Analytics, designed for intuitive web and product analytics. It offers a comprehensive suite of features without relying on cookies, making it a user-friendly and privacy-conscious choice for tracking website and application user behavior.
key_features: Core web analytics metrics (sessions, users, pageviews, bounce rate, duration)
Customizable dashboards for goals, retention, user journeys, and funnels
Support for organizations and unlimited sites
primary_use_case: Providing an intuitive, privacy-focused, and open-source alternative to Google Analytics for web and product analytics.
cover_image_prompt: A friendly, stylized frog character, representing 'Rybbit', sitting at a clean, modern dashboard. The frog is holding a magnifying glass over a flowing stream of digital data, highlighting key insights like user journeys and session replays. Instead of a traditional computer screen, the dashboard displays vibrant, easy-to-understand charts and maps. Subtle glowing particles emanate from the data stream, indicating privacy-friendly tracking. In the background, a stylized, simplified representation of a website's user flow is visible. The overall mood is clear, insightful, and approachable. The art style should be a 3D isometric illustration with a clean, bright color palette, emphasizing clarity and user-friendliness.

name: pdf-document-layout-analysis
description: A Docker-powered service for PDF document layout analysis. This service provides a powerful and flexible PDF analysis service. The service allows for the segmentation and classification of different parts of PDF pages, identifying the elements such as texts, titles, pictures, tables and so on.
readme_summary: This repository offers a Docker-powered microservice for advanced PDF document layout analysis, OCR, and content extraction. It segments and classifies elements like text, titles, and images, determines reading order, and supports conversion to formats like Markdown and HTML with translation.
key_features: Content extraction (text, titles, pictures, tables, formulas)
VGT (Vision Grid Transformer) and LightGBM models
primary_use_case: To provide a programmatic and interactive service for analyzing, understanding, and converting the content and structure of PDF documents.
cover_image_prompt: A master librarian meticulously organizing a chaotic library where books are scattered and pages are jumbled. The librarian uses a magical magnifying glass that, when held over a scattered page, reveals its true structure: the title glows, paragraphs align neatly, images separate from text, and tables form perfect grids. The magnifying glass also projects a digital blueprint of the organized content. Subtle glowing lines connect the organized elements, and a small, clean UI overlay shows the repository name 'pdf-document-layout-analysis'. The scene is set in a warm, inviting study with soft lighting, rendered in a 3D isometric illustration style with clear, distinct elements and a focus on the transformation from chaos to order.

name: OSINT-Framework
readme_summary: The OSINT Framework is a curated collection of free tools and resources designed to aid in information gathering and intelligence analysis. It categorizes resources by type and use case, making it easier for users to find relevant tools for reconnaissance, footprinting, and other OSINT tasks, with options for both online and locally installed tools.
key_features: Curated list of free OSINT tools and resources
Categorization by type and use case
Support for online and locally installed tools
Metadata for each tool (description, status, pricing, opsec, etc.)
Legend for tool markers (Tool, Google Dork, Registration, Manual URL edit)
Structured metadata fields for detailed tool information
Contribution guidelines for adding new resources
primary_use_case: To provide a centralized, easily navigable directory of free open-source intelligence (OSINT) tools and resources for information gathering and analysis.
cover_image_prompt: A wise old librarian standing in a vast, organized library, holding a magnifying glass over an open book. The book's pages are filled with glowing digital icons representing various online tools and data streams. The librarian is pointing to a specific icon, and from it, a beam of light illuminates a clear path through the shelves, revealing a treasure chest labeled 'Information'. Subtle UI elements and data visualizations float in the background, and the repository name 'OSINT Framework' is subtly etched on a nearby shelf. The scene is rendered in a 3D isometric illustration style with a warm, inviting color palette and soft, focused lighting, emphasizing discovery and accessibility.

name: agentic-rag-for-dummies
description: A modular Agentic RAG built with LangGraph — learn Retrieval-Augmented Generation Agents in minutes.
readme_summary: This repository provides a modular Agentic RAG system built with LangGraph, designed for learning and building advanced retrieval-augmented generation agents. It features hierarchical indexing, conversation memory, query clarification, and self-correction capabilities, offering both an interactive notebook for understanding and an extensible architecture for development.
primary_use_case: To serve as both a learning resource and a foundational architecture for building modular, agent-driven Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems.
cover_image_prompt: A wise old librarian meticulously organizing a vast, multi-layered library. Each layer represents different levels of information detail, from tiny scrolls (small chunks) to large, illuminated tomes (parent chunks). The librarian uses a magical magnifying glass to precisely locate specific information, then consults larger books for broader context. A subtle holographic interface hovers nearby, displaying a flowing graph of agent interactions and data retrieval paths. The scene is bathed in warm, intellectual light, with floating particles of knowledge connecting different sections of the library. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration, emphasizing clarity and depth, with a color palette of deep blues, golds, and parchment tones.
